name: desk
description: A place to write, with ideas kept to one side.

use.when: the person wants to write something longer than a note and keep the ideas for it beside the words.
use.not: a short note, which is a note record, or a to-do list, which is the week arrangement.
use.with: a note record once the writing is worth keeping on its own page.

items: An idea to come back to
props.label: Ideas
